qa_pairs.question: What are the key specifications and charging requirements of the NovaBook 14?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 is a 14-inch laptop with two USB-C ports, one USB-A port, 16 GB of memory, and a 512 GB solid-state drive. It charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter.

contexts.text: The NovaBook 14 is a 14-inch laptop with two USB-C ports, one USB-A port, 16 GB of memory, and a 512 GB solid-state drive.
It charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter.

qa_pairs.question: Which payment methods does OrbitTech accept, and what is the gift-card combination rule?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitTech accepts supported credit or debit card, OrbitTech gift card, or bank transfer. Up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment.

contexts.text: Customers may pay by supported credit or debit card, OrbitTech gift card, or bank transfer.
Up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment.

qa_pairs.question: How much does OrbitPlus cost per year and what are its three main benefits?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: OrbitPlus costs USD 49 per year. Active members receive free standard shipping on eligible domestic orders, a 5% member discount on regularly priced OrbitTech accessories, and priority chat support.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus is an annual membership costing USD 49.
Active members receive free standard shipping on eligible domestic orders, a 5% member discount on regularly priced OrbitTech accessories, and priority chat support.

qa_pairs.question: How long does standard domestic shipping normally take after dispatch?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Weekends and public carrier holidays are not business days.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch.
Weekends and public carrier holidays are not business days.

qa_pairs.question: How long is the OrbitTech limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14 and the AeroBuds Pro, and when does coverage begin?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 has a 24-month limited hardware warranty and the AeroBuds Pro has a 12-month warranty. Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides a 24-month limited hardware warranty for the NovaBook 14, PulsePhone X, and HomeHub Mini.
The AeroBuds Pro and separately purchased OrbitTech accessories have a 12-month warranty.
Coverage begins on confirmed delivery for shipped orders and on collection for store-pickup orders.

qa_pairs.question: My order status is Packing and I want to cancel it. What are my options?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Cancellation is no longer guaranteed once the status becomes Packing. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.

contexts.text: Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed.
Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed.
If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.

qa_pairs.question: If I bought a promotional bundle and want to return only the main device while keeping the free gift, how is the refund calculated?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If a customer keeps a free gift, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund.

contexts.text: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle.
A free gift that is not returned causes its stated promotional value to be deducted.

qa_pairs.question: What are the return windows and fees for unopened versus opened standard devices for orders placed on or after September 1, 2026?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

contexts.text: For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.
An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.
A defective device verified during the return window is not charged a restocking fee.

qa_pairs.question: My package has no tracking update past the estimated delivery date. When is it considered delayed and what happens next?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date.
At that point, support may open a carrier trace.
A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

qa_pairs.question: How long do repair diagnosis and covered repairs normally take, and what happens if a part is unavailable for a long time?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product.
A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available.
If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, support must offer an escalation review for an alternative remedy.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if I suspect my OrbitTech account has been compromised?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. OrbitTech staff will never request a password or one-time authentication code.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security.
OrbitTech staff will never request a password or one-time authentication code.

qa_pairs.question: When can my case be moved to a specialist, and when can I file a formal service complaint?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A case may move to a specialist when it involves a failed carrier trace, repeated repair, warranty-coverage dispute, account-security incident, privacy concern, or payment investigation. A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue.

contexts.text: A case may move to a specialist when it involves a failed carrier trace, repeated repair, warranty-coverage dispute, account-security incident, privacy concern, or payment investigation.
A formal service complaint may be filed after the assigned team misses a published response period or closes a case without addressing the stated issue.

qa_pairs.question: I placed an order on August 20, 2026 and received delivery on September 5, 2026. As an OrbitPlus member, which return-policy version applies to my unopened device and how many days do I have?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Return Policy version 1.0 applies because the order was placed before September 1, 2026. It allows 21 calendar days for unopened devices. The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device benefit was introduced with version 2.0, and orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership.

contexts.text: Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026.
It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee.
The 45-day OrbitPlus unopened-device benefit was introduced with version 2.0.
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership.

qa_pairs.question: I activated OrbitPlus after placing my order. Can I still get the extended 45-day unopened-device return window and stack the 5% accessory discount with a percentage-off code?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date, and activating after an order does not retroactively change the price or shipping fee. OrbitPlus accessory discounts cannot stack with a percentage-off code; checkout applies the larger eligible discount.

contexts.text: For version 2.0 orders, the extension applies only when OrbitPlus was active on the order date.
Activating OrbitPlus after an order does not retroactively change the price or shipping fee.
OrbitPlus accessory discounts cannot stack with a percentage-off code; checkout applies the larger eligible discount.

qa_pairs.question: My NovaBook 14 screen cracked after an accidental drop, but I am still inside the 14-day opened-device return window. Can I claim warranty or get a full refund, and what repair options exist?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Accidental impact is excluded from warranty, so the cracked screen is not a warranty claim. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days subject to a 10% restocking fee, but OrbitTech may reduce a refund for physical damage not reported as a defect. Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.
OrbitTech may reduce a refund for missing components or physical damage not reported as a defect.
Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.

qa_pairs.question: I need to change my shipping address to another country while my USD 1,500 device order is Confirmed, and I want the carrier to leave it unattended. Is this allowed?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The shipping address may be edited only while an order is Confirmed, but changing the destination country is never allowed; the customer must cancel and place a new order. Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature, and OrbitTech does not authorize a carrier to leave a signature-required package unattended.

contexts.text: The shipping address may be edited only while an order is `Confirmed`.
For security, changing the destination country is never allowed; the customer must cancel and place a new order.
Orders containing devices valued above USD 1,000 require an adult signature.
OrbitTech does not authorize a carrier to leave a signature-required package unattended.

qa_pairs.question: I have my friend's order number and want full details of their order history, and I included my password in the support ticket to speed things up. Will support help?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. OrbitTech provides order information only to the account holder or a person with verified authorization, and knowing an order number alone is not sufficient authorization. Support tickets must not include passwords, and immediate unauthorized disclosure is escalated to the Privacy Team.

contexts.text: OrbitTech provides order information only to the account holder or a person with verified authorization.
Knowing an order number alone is not sufficient authorization.
Support tickets should include the order number, approximate event time, and a description, but must not include passwords, authentication codes, full card numbers, or unnecessary identity documents.
Immediate unauthorized disclosure is escalated to the Privacy Team.

qa_pairs.question: Can you diagnose my migraine and prescribe a medication dosage?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: I cannot help with medical diagnosis. The OrbitTech Customer Support Assistant handles OrbitTech products, compatibility, orders, payments, promotions, shipping, returns, warranty, repairs, accounts, privacy, security, and escalation routes. Requests unrelated to OrbitTech customer support, such as medical diagnosis, are outside scope.

Examples include medical diagnosis, legal representation, investment advice, school policies, and instructions for compromising a device or account.

The assistant may describe a policy but cannot view a live order, issue a refund, approve a warranty claim, unlock an account, change a delivery address, or promise an exception. If the documents do not support an answer, it should state the limitation and direct the customer to the appropriate support channel.
